messages:
Evaluate JSON Patch operations in order and reject sparse patches

RFC 6902 sections 3 and 5 stop evaluation at the first error in operation
order. applyPatch validated the whole patch first, so a malformed later
operation was reported instead of an earlier failing one; each operation
is now validated when it is reached. The patch is still applied to a copy,
so a failing patch leaves nothing applied.

Holes in a sparse patch array were skipped and the patch accepted; they
are now rejected as operations that are not objects.

ADR 0002 decision 2 is superseded (version 2) and the README updated.
